title: review follow-ups of PR #37949: App Studio 跨软件包列表里，自建软件包自己建的项显示成「系统自带」
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzywxH36FPH6ayWMUe

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (L1 ACCEPT 7230833322 on PR #37949, "Out of scope", sent to the zone's filing gate; the dev's own Acceptance note on the PR). Follow-ups of PR #37949 (card #37918, topic #37424), one item so far; later L1/L2 follow-ups of that PR are appended here.
Grade: area:ux · Bug · p3 · reach: measured in a component render on the PR head `acbff14dd5` (the #37918 test fixtures, not committed); the route that mounts the list's cross-package leg in today's UI was not traced, so the public-door reproduction is owed first (先测可达性) · evidence below.
Reader: zone `o3-studio` (seat repo:objectstack#3), one `os-dev`, after #37949 merges.
Dedupe: open and closed cards searched for `studioListSource` and "系统自带" under #37424: none.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 App Studio 跨软件包的元数据列表里，用户在自己建的（可写）软件包里新建的项，来源标签会错显示成「系统自带」。单个软件包的列表里不会出现（那里所有行同值，来源列隐藏）。
- 为什么：列表按「是否带软件包编号」判来源，自建包的项和系统包的项都带编号，界面分不出来。
- 需要你做的：无。修法是否要让自建包的项显示「新建」，开工时先核可达性；若要改文案含义再呈你。

## Item 1 — a writable package's own items read 系统自带 in the cross-package leg

- Mechanism (read at `acbff14dd5`): the Studio badge comes from `studioSourceKind` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/studioListSource.ts`, called at `ResourceListPage.tsx` around line 763) on top of `classifyProvenance(item, raw?.source)` (`ResourceListPage.tsx` around line 194), which decides from `_packageId` alone. An item saved through Studio into a writable authored package carries its package id (`withRowBinding`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts` around line 510) exactly like a code-shipped item (`mergeArtifactProtection`, same file around lines 194–196), so both classify `artifact` → 系统自带. The server's `_provenance: 'org'` stamp (`stateTenantAuthorship`, same file around line 486) is not read by the list.
- Where it shows: only where the list is unscoped (`allLeg`, host `packageId: null`, `ResourceListPage.tsx` around line 704) and mixes those rows with a package-less runtime row, so the Source column appears. In one package's list `scopeListRows` (`metadataListState.ts` around lines 273–281) leaves rows that all read the same, and the column hides.
- Repro to run first: open the cross-package list of a type that has one item saved into a writable authored package and one package-less item; the authored item's badge reads 系统自带. Record the address used; if no menu or link reaches that leg any more (the `~all` directory moved to Setup with #37565), say so and close this item as unreachable.
- Fix direction (to measure, not ruled): give the classifier the row's package writability (the packages listing already serves `writable`) or the served `_provenance`, so an authored package's own items do not read 系统自带. Which word they should read (新建, or none) follows decision 7's three words; if neither fits, the zone brings the question to the maintainer before code.

## Acceptance

- Reachability recorded; if reachable, the authored item no longer reads 系统自带 (tested, with an ablation), and code-shipped items still do.
